topics.title: Governance and democracy
topics.objective: Explain how the 1992 Constitution, the arms of government and democratic principles promote good governance in Ghana.

topics.title: Elections and civic life
topics.objective: Analyse Ghana’s electoral processes and the civic rights and responsibilities of citizens.

topics.title: Media and national development
topics.objective: Assess the roles, ethics and effects of the media in Ghana’s national development.

topics.title: Population and migration
topics.objective: Evaluate the causes and consequences of population change and rural-urban migration in Ghana.

topics.title: Culture and globalization
topics.objective: Explain Ghanaian cultural values and how they can be preserved amid globalizing influences.

topics.title: Adolescent health and education
topics.objective: Analyse adolescent health issues and their consequences for education and life chances in Ghana.

topics.title: Agriculture and the economy
topics.objective: Explain the contribution of agriculture to employment, food security and industrial growth in Ghana.

topics.title: Environment and illegal mining
topics.objective: Evaluate the environmental and social effects of illegal mining and the measures available to control it.

topics.title: Work and unemployment
topics.objective: Describe the world of work, the types of unemployment and the measures that reduce youth unemployment.
